LABEL: free taenia coli
Definition: An organ component layer composed primarily of smooth muscle that forms one of the three longitudinal ribbons (taeniae) of the colon musculature, positioned anteriorly in the cecum, ascending colon, descending colon, and sigmoid colon, and inferiorly in the transverse colon.

LABEL: mesocolic taenia coli
Definition: An organ component layer composed primarily of smooth muscle that forms one of the three longitudinal ribbons (taeniae) of the colon musculature, present on the posteromedial surface of the cecum, ascending colon, descending colon, and sigmoid colon, and positioned posteriorly on the transverse colon at the site of attachment of the transverse mesocolon.

LABEL: omental taenia coli
Definition: An organ component layer composed primarily of smooth muscle that forms one of the three longitudinal ribbons (taeniae) of the colon musculature, situated posterolaterally in the cecum, ascending colon, descending colon, and sigmoid colon, and on the anterosuperior surface of the transverse colon where layers three and four of the greater omentum meet the transverse colon.

LABEL: connective tissue sheath
Definition: A layer of connective tissue that surrounds the epithelial components of the hair follicle, providing structural support and containing fibroblasts and extracellular matrix proteins including type I collagen.
